description: Methods for model interpretability, regulatory compliance, audit trails, fairness constraints, and governance frameworks for AI-driven trading systems.

techniques.name: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations)
techniques.description: Theoretically grounded feature importance method based on Shapley values from cooperative game theory. Widely adopted by quant funds. By Lundberg and Lee (2017), NIPS 2017. Over 29,000 citations.
techniques.verification_notes: Confirmed NIPS 2017 paper. Citation count verified. Adoption claim of ~60% of quant funds is unverified and likely inflated.

techniques.name: LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations)
techniques.description: Instance-level explanations via local linear approximations. Less stable than SHAP for financial time series but useful for model debugging.
techniques.verification_notes: Well-established XAI method. Limitations for time series acknowledged in literature.

techniques.name: EU AI Act Compliance for Financial AI
techniques.description: EU AI Act (effective August 2025) classifies financial AI systems as high-risk, requiring conformity assessments, transparency, human oversight, and documentation.
techniques.verification_notes: EU AI Act confirmed. Team 2 provided more detailed regulatory coverage including SR 11-7 and Bank of England SS1/23.

techniques.name: Neural Additive Models (NAMs)
techniques.description: Inherently interpretable neural networks that learn a linear combination of neural networks each attending to a single feature. Bridge gap between interpretability and performance.
techniques.verification_notes: Confirmed as a valid approach to interpretable deep learning. Financial applications are emerging.

techniques.name: SR 11-7 Model Risk Management Framework
techniques.description: Federal Reserve/OCC supervisory guidance (2011) providing four pillars for model risk: validation, documentation, governance, monitoring. Now explicitly applied to AI/ML/GenAI. Cornerstone of US bank model governance.
techniques.verification_notes: SR 11-7 confirmed as Federal Reserve guidance from 2011. Federal agencies (Fed, OCC, FDIC) have confirmed application to ML models. Four pillars verified.

techniques.name: SEC AI Washing Enforcement
techniques.description: SEC enforcement actions against firms exaggerating AI capabilities. First actions in March 2024 (Delphia, Global Predictions). 2025 examination priorities include AI integration review for investment advisers.
techniques.verification_notes: Verified: Delphia & Global Predictions charged March 2024 ($400K penalties). Rimar Capital Oct 2024. Presto Automation Jan 2025. Nate Inc. April 2025.

techniques.name: Neurosymbolic AI for Finance
techniques.description: Integrating rule-based reasoning with deep learning to improve interpretability while retaining predictive power. Emerging approach for compliance-aware trading systems.
techniques.verification_notes: Neurosymbolic AI is an emerging research direction. Financial applications are nascent but conceptually sound.

techniques.name: UK SS1/23 Model Risk Management
techniques.description: Bank of England/PRA supervisory statement on model risk management, complementing US SR 11-7 and EU AI Act for global regulatory convergence.
techniques.verification_notes: SS1/23 confirmed as PRA supervisory statement. Global regulatory convergence trend verified.
